'''September 1999 Bristol tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Bristol, CT on 26 September 1999. [[Steve Brentson]] won it. It is known from Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d58">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-02-bristol-connecticut-again-9-26-99d58/ bristol-connecticut-again-9-26-99], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 2 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-02-bristol-connecticut-again-9-26-99d58/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 September 1999
* '''Site:''' Bristol, CT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
